verdict.rationale: Codex is a coding agent, so this server-side axis would normally be na. However, the evidence shows Codex itself can run as an MCP server via `codex mcp-server`, so the axis applies. That server mode is labeled experimental in the GitHub interface doc and deprecated in the official docs, which point users to the Codex app server instead. Missing for 10: a supported, non-deprecated official MCP server mode, documentation of the tools it exposes to connecting agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Run Codex as an MCP server and connect an MCP client: codex mcp-server | your_mcp_client
codex mcp-server is deprecated. Use the Codex app server instead.
You can run Codex as an MCP server and connect it from other MCP clients.
